gold: Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis

selector.rationale: Optic Neuritis best explains the relative afferent pupil defect, central scotoma, impaired color and contrast vision, noticeable pupillary edema, and progression from discrete right papillary edema to severe optic nerve atrophy

rejected.label: SARS-CoV-2 infection
rejected.why: positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 does not directly explain the eye symptoms

rejected.why: while some findings support retinal vasculitis, they are not as comprehensive as those for Optic Neuritis
